headline: Argentine Merval Index Falls 3% as Peso Hits Record Low
summary: Argentina's Merval stock index dropped 3.0% and the wholesale peso hit a record low, while US-traded Argentine ADRs fell as much as 9.43%.
why: Argentina is undergoing rigorous economic reform under Javier Milei, with high exchange rate volatility and inflation weighing on capital markets.

impacts.name: Argentine Peso
impacts.why: Currency depreciation pressures deepened as broader market sell-offs hit South American equities.

why_moved: Argentine stocks and currency dropped sharply as regional market volatility spilled over into emerging market asset prices.
